title.narrative: PIMS-6733 GEF PPG Enhancing the Conservation in the Tian Shan mountain regions in Central and Eastern Kyrgyzstan

description.narrative: The objective of the GEF PPG is to develop the project concept into a full project: Enhancing the Conservation in the Tian-Shan Mountain regions in Central and Eastern Kyrgyzstan. As described in the project concept (PIF/child project concept note), this project aims to preserve local and global biodiversity and promote rational use of natural resources in the Central and Eastern regions of Kyrgyzstan. These globally significant Tien-Shan Mountain areas encompass protected areas (PAs), Key Biodiversity Areas (KBAs), Important Bird Areas (IBAs), and Ramsar wetlands like Lakes Issyk-Kul, Son-Kul, and Chatyr-Kul, hosting endangered species such as the snow leopard, Marco Polo sheep, and Siberian ibex. The region supports critical ecological services (water regulation, carbon sequestration) and Kyrgyzstan’s nomadic heritage, but faces threats from overgrazing, poaching, pollution, mining, tourism, and climate change.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
